description: The Workspace census across every Project, one count per health state in the closed vocabulary.

dirty.description: Present with an unclean working tree.

missing.description: The path is absent or not a worktree of the repository.

retired.description: Retired by the operator; the record is preserved.

unobserved.description: Present, but the last git status read could not complete.
